name: com.hiruai/creative-cloud
title: HiruAI Creative Cloud
description: Generate images, voice, music and video, then edit them into a finished movie from one plan.

tools.name: image_create
tools.description: Submit image work for the authenticated account. Returns an asynchronous request ID. For a sequence of work, prefer batch_submit and hand off the dashboard URL without polling. Use library IDs from assets_list where supported. Rights/privacy acknowledgements must reflect the user’s authorization; never invent consent. Limits remain active through result email delivery. Creative baseline: unless the user declined, build at least one dopamine hook from dopamine_hooks_get into this prompt, script or sound. First call image_models_get. Present dated original-model Arena scores (not scores of our quantized/LoRA recipes), traits, availability and native alternatives to help the user choose. Select one model; never invent agreement or substitute user consent for the operator's hosting permission. For quality-first image generation or editing, prefer the connected agent’s own image tool when it supports the requested operation, for example ChatGPT image generation and image editing. Check what this client actually exposes, including in Claude. Honor the user’s chosen provider. For anime-style character illustration, HiruAI Image offers WAI Illustrious SDXL v17 when available in image_models_get.

examples: A playful orange astronaut cat DJ on the Moon, cinematic mint lighting.

model.description: Select one available model from image_models_get, which supplies the current default, dated evidence, settings, and hosting permissions.

acknowledge_model_terms.description: Use true only after actual user authorization for the selected model. User consent never grants the platform hosting rights.

acknowledge_noncommercial.description: Use true only after actual user authorization for the selected model. User consent never grants the platform hosting rights.

inputSchema.description: Create one 1024x1024 image from one selected model. Read image_models_get and explain quality evidence and applicable consent before selection. Existing older paired results remain readable. Prompt 3–2000 characters.

mode.description: Audio policy. continuous: play ONE complete source once, preserve original pauses, cut visuals at measured sentence starts; requires all sentence IDs in order. scene_sources: each segment plays ITS OWN complete source file (scene Voice clone) once from sample 0 to the measured file end, never trimmed to ASR cue ends; requires all of that source's sentence IDs. segments: legacy SELECTED-REGION edit that trims each scene to ASR sentence spans with 20ms fades; it does not promise full-source coverage. Omitted mode means segments for backward compatibility; new plans should always state the mode.
mode.title: Mode

start_padding.description: continuous only: silence before the whole source, after any unbound intro clips.

end_guard.description: continuous and scene_sources: mandatory silence after the actual complete file end of the final narrated scene; never shrunk. ASR sentence end is NOT an audio trim boundary.

asset.description: Default narration for segments without their own asset. May be omitted when every segment has an asset.

duration_policy.description: expand chooses the next allowed duration that fits actual speech, up to 120 seconds. fixed stops if speech exceeds the selected duration.
duration_policy.title: Duration Policy

padding_policy.description: preserve keeps requested lead/tail. With fixed duration, shrink may proportionally reduce only lead/tail to fit; speech is never cut or sped up. For exact 15s shorts use fixed + shrink. If speech alone exceeds the budget, shorten the script or select fewer sentences.

tools.name: batch_submit
tools.description: Save the entire plan once and immediately hand the returned dashboard URL to the user. Do NOT poll or wait for completion. Server handles dependencies, GPU waits, studio/email locks and quota retries. Default start=false lets the user review and start on the dashboard. start=true requires user authorization for automatic execution and every acknowledgement. A submitted plan continues after the chat closes or session expires. Send the same dopamine_hooks you validated; they are recorded in goal for the user to review.

Revalidates the entire plan, preserves completed work, and pauses; use batch_control resume after repair. Never use for uncertain or accepted jobs.

tools.name: media_library_list
tools.description: List the account's media library (own recordings and referenced YouTube/TikTok/Instagram Reels/web videos) with status, tags, summary and reuse_policy. Respect reuse_policy: "reusable" footage (own/licensed) may be cut into new work; "reference_only" third-party media is for analysis, structure and style reference only, never copied into an output.

query.description: Search text for matching media library entries or moments.

origin.description: Filter to a source platform or the user’s own recording.

reuse_policy.description: Filter by the library’s recorded footage reuse policy.

tag.description: Filter entries by their saved tag.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries or matches to return.

tools.name: media_library_search
tools.description: Find moments across the library by speech, on-screen text, book-page text or visual similarity (multilingual CLIP). OCR includes book pages; book_page searches only book text and observed printed page labels. Returns item_id, start/end seconds, matched text, page_index (zero-based observation, not printed folio), printed_page and keyframe paths when available. Use for production planning and to pick clip ranges. Respect reuse_policy: "reusable" footage (own/licensed) may be cut into new work; "reference_only" third-party media is for analysis, structure and style reference only, never copied into an output.

query.description: Search text for matching media library entries or moments.

kinds.description: Choose which indexes to search: speech, OCR, visuals or book-page text.

reuse_policy.description: Filter by the library’s recorded footage reuse policy.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries or matches to return.

tools.name: media_library_get
tools.description: Read one library item's AI-ready manifest (schema hiruai.media-library.v1): provenance and reuse guidance, renditions, catalog (summary, chapters, reusable_segments, voice_reference_candidates, generation_prompts, sensitive flags), scenes with spoken text and OCR. Book-mode items also include book_pages (ordered OCR, observed printed_page, source timestamp/frame, confidence and warnings) and book_analysis coverage limits. Never infer missing pages or treat OCR scores as verified accuracy. include_transcript adds every timed transcript segment. Respect reuse_policy: "reusable" footage (own/licensed) may be cut into new work; "reference_only" third-party media is for analysis, structure and style reference only, never copied into an output.

item_id.description: UUID of the media library item.

include_transcript.description: Include every timed transcript segment in the manifest.

tools.name: media_library_clip
tools.description: Cut a frame-accurate H.264/AAC clip (max 180 s, location metadata removed) from a library item and, by default, save it to your private upload library for up to 30 days. Saving a clip may delete the oldest uploads that unfinished plans no longer need to make room. The returned upload asset_id can be used directly in Video uploads or as a Movie clip (service=upload). Only for reuse_policy=reusable items unless the user confirms they hold the rights.

item_id.description: UUID of the media library item.

start_seconds.description: Clip start offset in seconds from the beginning of the source.

end_seconds.description: Clip end offset in seconds from the beginning of the source.

rendition.description: Select the master or proxy as the source, or let the server choose.

max_height.description: Maximum height in pixels for the clipped output.

include_audio.description: Include the source audio in the clip when available.

save_as_asset.description: Save the clip to the private upload library for reuse in subsequent jobs.

confirm_reference_rights.description: Required true to cut a reference_only item; the user must state they hold permission.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key for the intended operation. Reuse it on network retries.

tools.name: dopamine_hooks_get
tools.description: Read the creative baseline catalog: everyday situations in which people feel reward and anticipation (dopamine hooks), each with visual, audio and situation cues and guardrails, plus the planning principle and this week's practice theme. Call before planning any creative work, then build at least one hook into the final output and declare it in batch_validate/batch_submit. Filter with group or ids. No generation, quota or GPU job.

group.description: Filter hooks to one catalog group.

ids.description: Filter hooks to the specified catalog IDs.

tools.name: video_reference_capabilities
tools.description: Read the deployed Video reference paths and GPU validation status. Distinguishes endpoint keyframes from full-video depth/canny/pose IC-LoRA. No generation.
